payload.name: Complete all visited places for enumeration questions
payload.description: When a question asks for all cities/places a person has visited (e.g., 'which cities has X visited?'), use this to avoid stopping after one destination.
content: When a question asks for all cities/places a person has visited, treat it as list completion: do not answer after the first location memory; continue searching for additional destinations.

Use travel-verb queries in addition to 'visited', including 'trip to', 'traveled to', 'went to', and 'vacation', and search event, state, and profile memories; do not rely only on the word 'city' in the query.

After each found destination, run at least one more search for another destination (e.g., person name plus 'trip' or 'also went to') before concluding; stop when a search returns no new unique destination or after at most two extra searches.

solves: Access agents often stop after the first location for questions asking for all cities/places a person has visited, missing additional destination memories worded with 'trip' or 'traveled to'. This adds an enumeration-completion step with bounded extra searches.
